# rain-refs: downloaded reference photographs (visual comparison only)

Downloaded 2026-10-02 for side-by-side checks of the rain / condensation
system. **None of these ship on the site.** All were fetched at ≤ 900 px on
the long side from the source's own image CDN (images.unsplash.com,
images.pexels.com). Each image was opened and looked at; the one-line
description is what I saw, not the site's caption.

Licences (both are free licences that allow use without attribution; credit
is listed anyway):

- **Unsplash License** ([unsplash.com/license](https://unsplash.com/license)):
  "download, copy, modify, distribute, perform, and use images from Unsplash
  for free, including for commercial purposes, without permission";
  attribution not required; not allowed: "compile images from Unsplash to
  replicate a similar or competing service". Only free (non-Unsplash+)
  photos were downloaded; the author names come from Unsplash's own JSON
  (`unsplash.com/napi/...`) for each photo.
- **Pexels License** ([pexels.com/license](https://www.pexels.com/license/)):
  "All photos and videos on Pexels are free to use", attribution not
  required; not allowed among others: "Don't sell unaltered copies",
  "Don't redistribute or sell the photos and videos on other stock photo or
  wallpaper platforms". Photographer names were checked on each photo's page.

Categories: **D** drops on a window by day · **N** at night / bokeh / lights ·
**C** close-ups of single drops (lens images) · **R** running drops, trails,
rivulets · **F** condensation (fog) with wiped, drawn or cleared tracks ·
**S** shadows / caustics / light through water onto a surface · **X** other
(splash, textured glass, dripping edge).

Gap: I could not find a freely licensed photograph of the classic "rain
shadow" (sunlight through a rain-covered window onto a wall) on Unsplash or
Pexels; Flickr's search is blocked to the fetcher and Wikimedia Commons was
not fetchable in this session. p01–p03 show the same optics (light through
drops onto a surface right behind them). Suggest photographing it: a lamp
or sun through a sprayed window onto white card at 2 cm, 10 cm and 50 cm.
